bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; prohibiting the burning of pesticide containers; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18B.07, subdivision 8.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18B.07, subdivision 8, is amended to read:

Subd. 8.
Pesticide, rinsate, and container disposal.
[+(a) +]A person may only dispose of pesticide, rinsate, and pesticide containers in accordance with this chapter and FIFRA. The manner of disposal must not cause unreasonable adverse effects on the environment.

[+(b) A person is prohibited from disposing a pesticide container by burning. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; prohibiting the burning of pesticide containers; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18B.07, subdivision 8.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18B.07, subdivision 8, is amended to read:

Subd. 8.
Pesticide, rinsate, and container disposal.
(a) A person may only dispose of pesticide, rinsate, and pesticide containers in accordance with this chapter and FIFRA. The manner of disposal must not cause unreasonable adverse effects on the environment.

(b) A person is prohibited from disposing a pesticide container by burning.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2026.
additions: (b) A person is prohibited from disposing a pesticide container by burning.
